conclusions.actual_decision_review: The same-day + active-defensive-war accept gate was not met (age1 and no active defensive war). This gate does not establish that refusing an otherwise legal alliance is strategically beneficial. Acceptance could provide useful deterrence/help, while reciprocal duties and current actor wars could impose cost; supplied observations do not resolve either direction.
conclusions.knowledge_closure: One exact known-source immutable interaction entry/facts was published in the new current state; the original unknown incident and its actual refusal remain unchanged. Source review is closed, material/counterfactual strategy quality is not fabricated.

must_bind: current sender and responder roles, pending ID, frame and channel
actual displayed native legal accept/reject and all selected send options
current alliance relation/creation eligibility and actor/recipient wars
effective useful strength and arrival/participation limits
after acceptance: independent actual alliance and old-pending disappearance
minimal_later_implementation_contract.would_change_only_when_complete: Compare marginal deterrence/support against reciprocal obligations/costs without an unconditional requirement that a defensive war already exists.

conclusions.recipient_AI_acceptance: Current source helper includes tier difference, opinions, personality, rival/nemesis, dynasty prestige, faith, relative military-power and other authored criteria; interaction ai_accept adds family/relations/heir, unity/struggle, legitimacy, Japanese noble-family and hunting branches. These are source expressions, not a current evaluated score or the autonomous player's alliance utility.
conclusions.unity_source_only: add_clan_unity_interaction_effect applies ordinary value only if both characters are clan, both have a house, and their houses match; the reversed non-house route additionally requires REVERSE_NON_HOUSE_TARGET=yes, while this alliance call supplies no. No current government/house match was supplied, so do not claim an actual unity loss.

source_build_claim: Exact current script bytes only; no new EXE/install/runtime qualification inferred.

add_clan_unity_interaction_effect = {
						CHARACTER = scope:puppet_or_actor
						TARGET = scope:recipient
						VALUE = scope:revoke_title_unity_loss
						DESC = clan_unity_title_revoked.desc
						REVERSE_NON_HOUSE_TARGET = no
					}

apply_clan_unity_interaction_effect = {
			CHARACTER = $CHARACTER$
			TARGET = $TARGET$
			DESC = $DESC$
			VALUE = $VALUE$
			VALUE_REVERSED = no
		}
